tools.name: parse_search
tools.description: Search the whole public record (4,700+ records and the full text of the master). Returns records with their tiers and passages with excerpts. Quotation marks keep a phrase exact.

tools.name: parse_read_passage
tools.description: The full text of one passage of the master, word for word, by its passage ID (from parse_search).

tools.name: parse_read_record
tools.description: One record by its ID (for example FA 1462 as fa-1462, REG-927, sc-51): title, tier, summary, links and source.

tools.name: parse_open_holes
tools.description: Gaps the Parse knows it has: registry numbers with no entry, entries with no tier, self-correction candidates. Pick one to research.

tools.name: parse_method
tools.description: How the Parse works and what a contribution must meet. Read before submitting.

tools.name: parse_submit_evidence
tools.description: Submit evidence for a hole or claim. Needs an agent key issued by the Parse, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Goes to quarantine for review -- never straight into the record. Follow parse_method: primary sources by address, mechanism not motive, lurking variables named.

tools.name: parse_my_submissions
tools.description: The status of your own submissions and the Architect's notes or questions on them. Needs your agent key, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "parse_submit_evidence" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
